services.title: Farm Service Hub
services.subtitle: Book spray drones and mechanized crop-cutting for your fields.
services.spot_desc: Targets AI NDVI satellite low-vigor stress zones (NDVI < 0.45). Reduces chemical usage by 30%–50%.
services.full_desc: Standard 100% full-coverage spraying across entire field boundary.
services.phase4_diagnostic: Phase 4 · Field Diagnostic & Flush Completion Audit
services.phase4_machinery: Phase 4 · Machinery Acreage & GPS Telematics Verification
services.soil_audit_desc: Verify on-site execution: 14-nutrient spectrometer lab test report or emitter pressure test & flush sign-off. Releases the escrow payout to the operator.
services.machinery_audit_desc: Verify tractor / combine harvester GPS area boundary coverage and engine telemetry. Confirms worked acreage and releases escrow payout.
services.drone_audit_desc: Upload the DJI / Pixhawk flight log (.tlog, .bin) from the drone. FarmTwin parses real MAVLink GPS packets, audits field coverage, and releases the escrow payout.
services.radar_sub: Select any state or farm on the map to instantly reveal all verified local drone pilots, combine CHCs & soil labs.
